product.label: (02) — The product
product.reducedHeading: Built to run the whole job.

shots.title: From dispatch to done, on one board.
shots.body: Assign the right technician and watch every job move through the flow in real time — no status calls, no spreadsheets.

shots.title: Every site and technician, on the map.
shots.body: Geofenced sites and live GPS mean dispatch always knows where the field is — and where each job sits.

shots.title: Your whole operation, in real time.
shots.body: A live activity feed, pending approvals and every space at a glance — the office view of the field.

shots.title: Plan across every space.
shots.body: A timeline across all your sites, recurring jobs and availability — capacity you can actually see.

process.label: (03) — Process
process.heading: From a task in the office to a signed report in the field.

steps.desc: Admin raises a task with location, due date, photos and priority.
Dispatcher checks availability and assigns — the technician gets an instant push.
Technician taps En Route; background GPS records the exact path and marks Arrived.
Photos, parts and notes on site, then a signed service report — even offline.
The report syncs to the office with the full route and audit trail attached.

features.title: Locked-screen GPS
features.desc: A native background service keeps recording the route with the screen off.

features.title: Distance-based sampling
features.desc: A point every 25 metres — idle time at a site costs no extra battery.

features.title: Offline-safe capture
features.desc: Photos, notes and reports queue on device and sync when signal returns.

features.title: Dual signatures
features.desc: Technician and customer sign on-device to close the job on site.

shots.title: Their day, the moment they open it.
shots.body: Clock-in, today's jobs and what's urgent — the technician sees the whole shift at a glance.

shots.title: Every job, from accept to done.
shots.body: Accept, start, block or complete — the full status flow in their pocket, synced to the office in real time.

shots.title: Clock in on site — verified.
shots.body: Geofenced clock-in with the assigned location and a full history, so hours are provable, not guessed.

shots.title: The whole crew, one tap away.
shots.body: Message or call any teammate across every space, straight from the field.

footer.tagline: Dispatch, track and prove every job — the office and the field, on one platform.

why.label: (05) — What makes us special
why.heading: Three tools in one — cheaper, and one login.
why.lead: Most field businesses pay for a field-service tool, a time-clock and a GPS tracker separately — three bills, three logins, and hours spent reconciling them. HBCField is all three, in one system.
why.diffLabel: And things the others charge extra for — or don't have at all

diffs.title: Exact background-route GPS
diffs.body: The real road path a technician drove, captured even when the phone is locked. Premium even in the FSM world — most gate it behind their top tier.

diffs.title: A real overtime engine
diffs.body: Policy-based overtime detection, geofenced auto-clock-out and an approval flow — far beyond a bolt-on time clock.

diffs.title: Multi-org & cross-team delegation
diffs.body: Franchises, subcontractors and agencies can manage many client organizations from one account — enterprise-grade, rare in SMB tools.

diffs.title: Configurable to your workflow
diffs.body: Custom fields, task types, recurring jobs and workflows mean the system bends to how you already work — a platform, not a rigid app.

industries.label: (06) — Who it's for
industries.heading: Built for field teams of every kind.
industries.lead: Wherever people do the work on the ground, HBCField coordinates it — and shows exactly who it helps, how, and what you save.

fields.name: Property & facility management
fields.who: Landlords, property and facility managers running many buildings and units.
fields.how: Tenant requests become dispatched tasks, geofenced clock-in per building, photo and signed service reports, plus recurring safety checks — heating, smoke detectors — on a live map with a full audit log.
fields.benefit: One coordinator oversees more units, hours are verified, compliance is documented, and tenants get a faster response.

fields.name: HVAC, plumbing & electrical trades
fields.who: Installation and repair contractors with mobile technicians.
fields.how: Jobs assigned by location and priority, a clear status flow from en route to arrived to completed, service reports with parts used and a customer signature, then invoicing.
fields.benefit: Faster job turnaround, provable labour and parts, and quicker billing.

fields.name: Cleaning & janitorial services
fields.who: Commercial cleaning firms running recurring rounds across sites.
fields.how: Recurring tasks per site, geofenced clock-in that proves attendance, and checklists via custom fields.
fields.benefit: No missed rounds, verified presence, and less supervision.

fields.name: Security & guarding
fields.who: Security firms running patrols and inspections.
fields.how: Scheduled recurring patrol tasks, timestamped geofenced check-ins, GPS route proof, and photo incident reports.
fields.benefit: Verifiable coverage for clients and far fewer disputes.

fields.name: Landscaping & grounds maintenance
fields.how: GPS route-tracked visits, recurring seasonal schedules, and before/after photos.
fields.benefit: Efficient routing, documented work, and clear proof for clients.

fields.name: Equipment & appliance repair
fields.who: Field teams maintaining machines and assets on customer sites.
fields.how: Asset-linked tasks with a full maintenance history, service reports with parts, recurring maintenance and signatures.
fields.benefit: A complete history per asset, faster repeat visits, and provable warranty work.

compare.label: (08) — Compare
compare.heading: Every feature, by plan.
compare.lead: Exactly what each plan unlocks — tiers are cumulative, so every plan includes everything below it.

subtasks.label: Subtasks
subtasks.desc: Split a big job into smaller steps you can assign and track on their own, so nothing slips through the cracks.

checklists.label: Checklists
checklists.desc: Add a tick-off list of steps to any task so your team follows the same process every time and never misses one.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.desc: Attach photos, PDFs, and documents straight to a task — everything about the job lives in one place.

dependencies.label: Dependencies
dependencies.desc: Link tasks so one can’t start until another finishes, keeping multi-step jobs in the right order.

custom_fields.label: Custom Fields
custom_fields.desc: Capture the extra details your business needs — reference numbers, equipment models, anything — with your own fields on every task.

tracking.label: Route Tracking
tracking.desc: See exactly where your field team is on a live map and replay the route they drove to each job.

service_reports.label: Service Reports
service_reports.desc: Turn a finished job into a professional report with photos, parts used, and a customer signature — ready to share or bill.

time_tracking.label: Time Tracking
time_tracking.desc: Record how long jobs actually take versus the estimate, so you can quote and schedule more accurately.

sprints.label: Sprints
sprints.desc: Plan work in short, focused cycles and see at a glance how much your team completes each round.

story_points.label: Story Points
story_points.desc: Score each task by effort so you can balance workloads and predict how much fits in a week.

epics.label: Epics
epics.desc: Bundle many related tasks under one big initiative to track large projects from start to finish.

phases.label: Phases
phases.desc: Break a project into stages — like planning, execution, and handover — and watch progress move through each.

recurring.label: Recurring tasks
recurring.desc: Set a job to repeat daily, weekly, or monthly and the system creates it automatically — no manual re-entry.

overtime.label: Overtime
overtime.desc: Let staff request extra hours and managers approve them, with every minute logged for payroll.

invoicing.label: Invoicing
invoicing.desc: Turn completed work into an invoice in a couple of clicks and keep track of what’s been paid.

workflows.label: Custom workflows
workflows.desc: Build your own task stages — the exact steps your business uses — instead of a fixed status list.

audit_log.label: Audit log
audit_log.desc: Keep a complete record of every action, so you always know who changed what and when.

priority_routing.label: Priority queue routing
priority_routing.desc: Your tickets jump the queue ahead of lower plans, so you’re answered sooner when it’s busy.

live_chat.label: Live chat
live_chat.desc: Chat with a real person in real time, right inside the app, when an agent is online.

dedicated_support.label: Dedicated contact & onboarding
dedicated_support.desc: A named contact and an onboarding call — hands-on help tailored to your team.

pricing.label: (07) — Pricing
pricing.heading: Priced to replace three tools.
pricing.lead: Pay for the office seats, add the field for less. 14-day trial, no credit card.

outcomes.title: End the status-call chaos
outcomes.body: A live board and map replace the “where are you?” calls and the end-of-day spreadsheet.

outcomes.title: Prove every hour
outcomes.body: Geofenced clock-in and an audit trail turn payroll disputes into a non-issue.

outcomes.title: Document every visit
outcomes.body: Photos, parts and signed reports mean you can always show exactly what was done.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: HBCField — Field Service Management Platform
privacy.intro: HBC Group GmbH ("we", "our", "us") operates the HBCField mobile application and web platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.accountRole: Role and permissions within your organization
s1.gpsIntro: — collected only during active work activities:
s1.gps1: When driving to a job site (EN_ROUTE status) — your route is recorded continuously in the background, even when the app is closed or not in use
s1.gps2: When clocking in or out (single GPS fix for attendance verification)
s1.gps3: When marking arrival at a job site (geofence verification)
s1.cachedText: — used for presence indicators on the dispatcher's live map. This uses the device's last known position without activating the GPS radio.
s1.neverPost: when you are browsing tasks, viewing your profile, or outside active work — that is, when you are not driving to a job and not clocked in.
s1.work2: Clock in/out times and break durations
s1.work3: Service reports including text descriptions, photos you take with your device camera or select from your photo library, and digital signatures
s1.device1: Device type and operating system (for push notifications)

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.item1: To provide field service management functionality
s2.item2: To enable real-time location tracking for dispatchers during active work
s2.item3: To verify attendance via geofencing at company locations
s2.item4: To verify employee presence at job sites before starting work
s2.item5: To send push notifications for task assignments, status updates, and comments
s2.item6: To generate service reports and maintain work history
s2.item7: To display route tracking on completed tasks
s2.item8: To improve app performance and fix bugs

s3.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
s3.intro: Where the General Data Protection Regulation applies, we process your personal data on the following legal bases:
s3.contractText: — to provide the HBCField service to your organization and to you as an authorized user, including task assignment, location-based dispatching, attendance verification, and service reporting.
s3.legitText: — to secure our platform, prevent fraud and abuse, maintain service reliability, and improve the product. Our legitimate interests are balanced against your rights and freedoms.
s3.consentText: — for optional features such as push notifications, which you can disable at any time in your device settings.
s3.legalText: — where we are required to retain records for tax, labor, or other statutory obligations applicable to your organization.

s4.title: 4. Data Sharing
s4.noSellPost: sell your personal data to third parties.
s4.internal: Your data is shared only within your organization — admin and dispatcher users can see employee locations and work activity.
s4.thirdPartyIntro: We use the following third-party services:

s5.title: 5. Data Storage & Security
s5.euPre: All data is stored on servers located in the
s5.item2: Data is encrypted in transit using TLS/HTTPS
s5.item3: Passwords are hashed using bcrypt with cost factor 12
s5.item4: Authentication tokens are SHA-256 hashed before storage
s5.item5: Refresh tokens use rotation with grace periods for concurrent requests
s5.item6: Access is restricted by role-based permissions (RBAC)
s5.item7: Rate limiting protects against brute-force attacks (10 req/sec, 200 req/min)
s5.item8: Account lockout after 5 failed login attempts (15-minute cooldown)
s5.item9: File uploads are stored in S3-compatible object storage with presigned URLs

s6.title: 6. Data Retention
s6.item1: Account data is retained while your account is active
s6.item2: Location history (route tracking) is retained for 90 days
s6.item3: Service reports are retained according to your organization's record-keeping requirements
s6.item4: Refresh tokens are automatically cleaned up after expiration
s6.item5: You can request complete data deletion at any time

s7.title: 7. Your Rights (GDPR)
s7.intro: If you are located in the European Union or European Economic Area, you have the following rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
s7.accessText: — Request a copy of your personal data
s7.erasureText: — Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten"). You can delete your account and all associated data yourself, at any time, directly in the app: Profile → Account → Delete Account.
s7.portabilityText: — Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
s7.objectText: — Object to processing of your personal data
s7.withdrawText: — Withdraw your consent at any time
s7.complaintText: — You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority if you believe your rights have been infringed.
s7.contactPre: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at

s8.title: 8. Location Tracking Disclosure
s8.intro: HBCField uses location data as a core part of its field service management functionality. Here is exactly when and how location is used:
s8.drivingText: Continuous background tracking — even when the app is closed or not in use — approximately every 15 seconds, to record your route to the job site
s8.clockText: Single high-accuracy fix for attendance verification
s8.arrivingText: Single high-accuracy fix for geofence verification (20m radius)
s8.inactive1: Browsing tasks, viewing profile, changing settings
s8.inactive2: The app is in the background or closed and you are not driving to a job (route tracking) or clocked in
s8.inactive3: Presence indicator uses cached OS location only (no GPS activation)
s8.safeguard1: Only dispatchers and admins within your organization can see your location
s8.safeguard2: Location data is never shared outside your organization
s8.safeguard3: Route data from completed tasks is retained for 90 days
s8.safeguard4: You can see your own location data in the app

s9.title: 9. Push Notifications
s9.disable: You can disable push notifications in your device settings at any time.

s10.title: 10. Children's Privacy
s10.body: HBCField is a workplace application designed for professional use. It is not intended for use by individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

s11.title: 11. International Data Transfers
s11.body: Your data is processed and stored within the European Union. Push notification delivery may involve routing through Google (FCM) or Apple (APNs) infrastructure, which may process data outside the EU. These transfers are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.

s12.title: 12. Changes to This Policy
s12.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify users of material changes via email or in-app notification. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when this policy was last revised.

privacy.footerRights: HBC Group GmbH. All rights reserved.

s4.title: 4. Accounts & Organizations

s5.title: 5. Subscriptions, Seats & Plans
s5.intro: The Service is offered on a subscription basis across several plan tiers, billed either monthly or annually. The features available to your Organization depend on the tier you select.
s5.seats: Billing is per seat, not per bundle. Every active Member counts as a seat: an office seat (any Member with web-portal access, including the Admin) is priced at the tier rate, while a field seat (a mobile-only Member) is charged at a flat rate. A Member's seat type follows their access — if you grant or revoke web access, their seat type changes accordingly, and your seat counts re-sync.
s5.fieldText: €19 per mobile-only seat / month (€190 / year), on any tier.
s5.plansNote: Prices are exclusive of VAT and may be updated for future terms with notice. Your current plan and seat counts are always shown in Settings → Billing.

s6.title: 6. Fees, Billing & Proration
s6.intro: Fees are charged in euro (EUR) in advance for each billing period, based on the plan and seat counts in effect. When you add or remove seats mid-period, the amount is prorated as follows:
s6.monthlyText: changes are prorated and applied to your next invoice; adding seats does not trigger an immediate separate charge, but the prorated amount for the remainder of the current period is added to the following invoice.
s6.annualText: an increase is invoiced immediately, prorated for the remainder of the annual term, so added seats are not free until renewal.
s6.decreaseText: reductions never trigger a cash refund; the prorated value is banked as an account credit and applied to future invoices.
s6.processor: Payments are processed by Stripe. You authorize us and Stripe to charge your payment method for all fees due. You are responsible for keeping a valid payment method on file.

s7.vatId: Business customers may enter a valid VAT identification number (UID) at checkout. For eligible cross-border transactions within the EU, the reverse-charge mechanism applies and no VAT is charged, in which case you are responsible for accounting for VAT in your own country. Domestic Austrian supplies remain subject to Austrian VAT even where a VAT ID is provided.

s8.expiry: Unless you subscribe to a paid plan before the trial ends, access is restricted at the end of the trial and the account is placed in a read-only state until a subscription is started. We may change or discontinue trial offers at any time.
